Oct 29, 2026 (S&P 500 fell 0.38%):
- **Alphabet** fell 12.64%. It filed its quarterly report (10-Q) the same day, but that filing alone doesn't show why the stock dropped: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1652044/000165204426000084/goog-20260930.htm
- **Amazon** fell 4.25%. It posted its quarterly results the same day in a current-events report (8-K): https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1018724/000101872426000038/amzn-20261029.htm
- **Eli Lilly** rose 6.63%. It posted its quarterly results in a current-events report (8-K) and filed its quarterly report (10-Q) the same day: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/59478/000005947826000104/lly-20261029.htm
- **Meta** filed a current-events report (8-K) about a major agreement, a change to shareholders' rights and a change to its company rules. It also registered securities with an exchange (8-A12B). The stock didn't move unusually: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1326801/000119312526438017/d183592d8k.htm
